profile.name: Devil Jin
profile.overview: Devil Jin is an explosive, high-risk high-reward Mishima-style character. As a Mishima, Devil Jin has access to the Electric Wind God Fist, Flash Punch Combo (1,1,2), a Demon Paw (f,F+2) that establishes respect in neutral, and a Demon Steel Pedal (b+4) that grants him incredible okizeme.
profile.playstyle: Explosive Mishima. Threaten the Wind God Fist (EWGF in Heat or with perfect input), Demon's Paw and the hellsweep from a crouch dash, and fly into Mourning Crow (MCR) for aerial pressure. Big reward, big risk: Wavu notes his hellsweep is his only truly threatening low.
strengths: Mishima: Access to the Mishima toolkit, including the EWGF, Flash Punch Combo, a launching Hellsweep, a Demon Paw, and a Demon Steel Pedal.
High-Risk, High-Reward: Extremely explosive 50/50s from his wavedash mixup and in Mourning Crow stance during Heat.
Brutal Comboes & Okizeme: Excellent combo damage coupled with high wall carry and damaging wall comboes setting up his incredible okizeme.
Strong Approach: Large collection of robust and safe approach tools, combined with his Mourning Crow stance.
Excellent Punishment: Some of the best whiff punishers in EWGF and uf+1, a very good i10 punish (1,1,2), one of the best i11 WS punishers (ws4,4), and a rare i14 WS launcher (ws2).
Panic Buttons: Highly evasive defensive options in u+4 and b+3, coupled with a reversal in b+1+3, allowing Devil Jin to punish opponents for attempting to take their turn.
Complete Throw Game: Devil Jin has access to a complete set of command throws (1,2, & 1+2 breaks).
weaknesses: I Have No Lows & I Must Hellsweep: Devil Jin's Hellsweep is the only truly threatening low in his kit, forcing him to commit to a stagger low at all times in order to condition opponents.

Living On The Edge: His gameplan is an extremely risky one. Mourning Crow is susceptible to being floated, most string extensions are launch punishable, his wavedash mixup consists of two unsafe main options, and his aforementioned panic buttons are death on block.
Mechanically Demanding: Many difficult execution requirements are necessary, such as performing ws2 out of a wavedash, performing EWGF consistently, or making the most out of every launcher.
Subpar Generic Tools: Generally limited generic tools with mediocre poking and a stubby jab.
Underwhelming Mids: Mids often either end his turn on block with not much reward on hit, or are very risky to throw out.

stances.name: Mourning Crow
stances.entry: df+2 or ws3 with F on hit, and other transitions
stances.note: Flight stance: MCR.2,2 is a Heat Engager, MCR.3 instantly tornadoes (+70a on hit).

heat: Allows Annihilation Beam followups after certain moves
Can perform EWGF without perfect input
Allows the use of Spinning Demon Leviathan and Inner Purgatory

keyMoves.summary: i11 special mid crouch jab, -4 on block.
Wind God Fist: i11 high launcher, -10 on block. In Heat it becomes the EWGF (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: His signature launcher: fast, long and huge.
keyMoves.use: As a punisher, a whiff punish and in neutral from a crouch dash.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Practise the crouch dash motion until it is automatic.

keyMoves.summary: Double Lift Kicks: i15 launcher, -15 on block.

keyMoves.use: After lows that are -14 or worse.

keyMoves.gamePlan: Use when ws2 is too slow.

keyMoves.summary: Demon's Paw: i15 mid, -8 on block, Heat Engager.
keyMoves.purpose: A safe, long mid that starts Heat.

keyMoves.summary: Demon Steel Pedal: i17 mid, launches on counter hit (+30a), -8 on block.
Aratama Strike: i20 mid, +3c on block, spikes.
keyMoves.purpose: A plus mid that keeps the turn.

keyMoves.summary: Hellsweep: i16 low from a crouch dash, -23c on block.
keyMoves.use: Once the opponent respects the Wind God Fist.
keyMoves.gamePlan: The low half of his Mishima mix-up.

keyMoves.summary: Broken Plate: i18 low, -12 on block.
Judgment: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.

combos.name: Instant tornado BnB: 3,1 b,f+2,1,2
combos.situation: After an instant tornado such as ws2.
mistakes: Pressing 3,1 too late: the opponent is already spinning low.
Mixing up b,f+2 with f+2: it is back, then forward.
